scope: Only tests/WinAudioClean.Preview.Tests.ps1; runner also performed parser, static-analysis and governance-plan prechecks. This is not the Full gate.
coverage: Strict invariant range strings, default 45-second clipping, explicit duration bounds and sample-aligned 5-second context.
Source-relative selected-track origin and timestamp-resolution validation, WAV sample-zero/sample-rate fallbacks, malformed/coarse metadata rejection, nonzero absolute seek arguments.
Common-target finite attenuation-only matching, fractional true-peak guard, silence/subsecond reasons and invariant argument construction.
Ten child-CLI preflight rejection cases prove configuration exit 2 precedes native executable resolution and destination creation.

Thirteen real Windows IO transaction and held-handle orchestration cases exercise success, cancellation, native and measurement failures, exact frame count, publication race, report failure and unmeasurable matching.
methodLimit: Fault orchestration mocks native audio processing and metadata while retaining real IO ownership, WAV validation, publication and normal report writing. Unit and rejected-CLI checks do not constitute real-media DSP or listening evidence.
sanitization: Checkout/user-profile paths and ANSI formatting removed; line endings and trailing whitespace normalized. Test content and outcomes retained.
supersedes: Earlier focused 126-case runs covered the prior 25511872 helper snapshot. These 149-case runs cover the final 0d446a37 timestamp-resolution extension and frozen test file.
